title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Downtime Credit: Lost Days and Net Daily Rental Cost
content:
**Entitlement.** A downtime credit is owed on a Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement whose return inspection recorded the malfunction as confirmed and found no damage caused by misuse; it is booked once per agreement, against the most recent malfunction report on the agreement, and it takes effect when the renter accepts it as the remedy for the breakdown.

**Rental days.** The rental days of the downtime credit are the daily periods billed, plus 7 for each weekly period, 28 for each four-week period, half a day for each four-hour period and 2 for a weekend special.

**Net daily rental cost.** The net daily rental cost is the rental time billed plus the engine overtime charge billed, less the ProBuild rental discount posted, divided by the rental days of the downtime credit.

**Lost days.** When the most recent malfunction report was made on the checkout date, the lost days are all the rental days of the downtime credit; otherwise the lost days are the calendar days from the date of the most recent malfunction report to the return date.

**Credit.** The downtime credit is the lost days multiplied by the net daily rental cost, rounded to the nearest cent once at the end. The net daily rental cost is not rounded on the way.

## Terms

- *Most recent malfunction report*: the malfunction report on the agreement registered last; its date is the calendar date of its registration.
- *Rental time billed, engine overtime charge billed, ProBuild rental discount posted*: the totals of those lines on the agreement.

## Worked examples (hypothetical agreements)

**A.** Rental time billed 700.00 (one weekly period), engine overtime charge billed 63.00, ProBuild rental discount posted 70.00. Rental days 7; net daily rental cost 693.00 divided by 7, that is 99.00. Checked out 2 March, most recent report 5 March, returned 9 March: lost days 4; credit 396.00. Had the report been made on 2 March, the lost days would be all 7 and the credit 693.00.

**B.** Rental time billed 1000.00 for 3 daily periods, no overtime, no discount. Net daily rental cost 333.333...; report two calendar days before the return date: 2 lost days, 666.666..., rounded once at the end to 666.67.

## Entitlement table

| Return inspection | Credit owed |
|---|---|
| malfunction confirmed, no misuse found | yes, once per agreement |
| malfunction confirmed, misuse found | no |
| malfunction not confirmed | no |
